title: org_units_2027.csv
description: The units on the newest City org chart: departments and the bureaus under them, with chart pages and links to their descriptions.

unit.description: The bureau or office; empty on a department's own row.

kind.description: department = the department itself; bureau = a unit under it; whole-department = a department with no separate units; department-wide = lines that belong to the department, not one bureau.

division.description: The division the bureau belongs to, where the chart prints one.

descriptions.description: Description ids (from the descriptions file) for this unit; [n-m] picks paragraphs.

aliases.description: Other ids that mean the same unit.

examples: The Mayor's department. Chart p1 shows Chief of Staff, Office of the Solicitor and Bure...
